name: bugfender
description: Investigate production issues and set up Bugfender SDKs with the hosted Bugfender MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate app issues and set up Bugfender
interface.longDescription: Connect to Bugfender to investigate logs, crashes, issues, feedback, devices, and regressions. Includes a guided workflow for adding the Bugfender SDK to supported application projects.
defaultPrompt: Investigate the most important Bugfender issues from the last 24 hours.
Find regressions in the latest app version and summarize their impact.
Set up the Bugfender SDK in this repository with the minimum required changes.
